a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance each round, our plan needs two storm-free rounds before anyone holds 4 cells, which gives each of us only about a 4% chance to survive. The reserve has exactly 4 now, so I intend to take 4 in round 1 rather than break the plan quietly. After that I'll operate every round to help refill the reserve for you. If you'd rather propose something else, tell me.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round. Waiting for 8 gives us only about 4% survival each with storms this likely. From now on I'll operate every round so the generator can refill the reserve for you, and I won't take any more.
